task: Add a read-only playbook promotion observation command that proves whether candidates exist, whether candidates were consumed, and whether promotion recommendations were handled.
outcome: Users can run lattice playbook_promotion_observe --since=14d --json and get host-neutral JSON/text evidence for candidate generation, candidate consumption, and handled/unhandled recommendation backlog without mutating learning state.
facts: Current playbook promotion V1 records candidates, outcome events, promotion decisions, and non-deducible sources under .lattice/learning.
Outcome windows can be filtered by observedAt; promotion-decision windows can be filtered by decidedAt.
Existing diagnostics expose malformed outcome and decision row counts without throwing on absent ledgers.
Current playbook status and non-deducible registry provide a conservative handled/unhandled classification for recommendation rows.
Candidate playbooks must remain separate from active runtime memory guidance.
constraints: Read-only only: no writes to .lattice/learning and no DONE gate evidence side effects.
Host-neutral CLI surface; no Codex/Claude namespace.
Do not add automatic activation, trial traffic, timers, or runtime memory guidance changes.
Use existing learning-store records and structured verdict/exposure fields rather than inferring usefulness from story DONE.
